providers.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
providers.service_territory: Denver metro, Boulder, Fort Collins, Colorado Springs, Pueblo, and most of northern/central Colorado — approximately 1.6 million electric customers
providers.notes: Largest IOU in Colorado; operates as Public Service Company of Colorado (PSCo). Business Solutions Center: EnergyEfficiency@xcelenergy.com. Rate book: xcelenergy.com/Rates. Filed $356M electric rate case Nov 2025.

providers.service_territory: Pueblo, Colorado Springs area, and southeastern Colorado (electric service territory)
providers.notes: Subsidiary of Black Hills Corporation (NYSE: BKH). Commercial electric rebate contact: 888-391-8702. EV charging rebate: ReadyEV@blackhillscorp.com. SBDI program contact: BlackHillsSBDI@franklinenergy.com.

providers.service_territory: Roaring Fork Valley, Eagle County, Garfield County, Glenwood Springs, Aspen, and surrounding mountain communities in western Colorado
providers.notes: Electric cooperative; 90%+ clean energy delivered. Partners with Energy Smart Colorado (CORE and Walking Mountains Science Center). Commercial rebate applications submitted via holycross.com/rebates.

providers.service_territory: Grand County, Jackson County, and portions of Larimer and Summit counties (northern mountain communities)
providers.notes: Electric cooperative. Distributes power purchased from Tri-State G&T. Commercial rebate program scope may be limited; customers encouraged to check DSIRE and cooperative website.

providers.service_territory: Delta, Montrose, Ouray, and Gunnison counties in western Colorado
providers.notes: Electric cooperative in western Colorado. Member of Tri-State G&T. Commercial rebate program available for members.

providers.service_territory: Larimer and Weld counties, northeastern Colorado (Fort Collins metro rural areas)
providers.notes: Electric cooperative. Commercial rebate programs available for members; participates in Tri-State and Touchstone Energy efficiency resources.

providers.service_territory: Colorado Springs and surrounding El Paso County municipalities
providers.notes: Municipal utility (City of Colorado Springs). Offers commercial energy efficiency rebate programs for electric customers. Separate from Black Hills Energy service territory.

programs.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
programs.stacking_rules: Cannot combine with Custom Efficiency for same measure
programs.program_notes_ai: Prescriptive rebates are preset for specific equipment categories including LED lighting, HVAC, motors/VFDs, refrigeration, data center, and more. Preapproval is NOT required for prescriptive track. DLC or ENERGY STAR qualification required for LED lighting; non-qualified LEDs receive 75% of standard rebate. Most prescriptive programs carry a 60% project cost rebate cap. Program restarted Oct. 1, 2024 after a temporary budget-related pause. Business Solutions Center: 855-839-8862.

programs.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
programs.stacking_rules: Cannot combine custom + prescriptive for same measure
programs.program_notes_ai: Covers equipment not eligible under prescriptive programs. Pre-approval is REQUIRED; pre-approval review takes approximately 10 business days. Incentive calculated per kWh/kW saved on a project-by-project basis. Covers compressed air, process efficiency, standard offer, recommissioning, refrigeration recommissioning, and other non-prescriptive measures.

programs.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
programs.stacking_rules: After study completion, customer may apply for prescriptive or custom rebates based on study recommendations
programs.program_notes_ai: Xcel Energy covers up to 75% of the cost of specific engineering studies. All studies require pre-approval for funding. Includes: Commercial Real Estate, Compressed Air, Data Center Efficiency, Energy Analysis, Lighting Redesign, Process Efficiency, Recommissioning, Refrigeration Recommissioning, Standard Offer. Study results can be parlayed into downstream prescriptive or custom rebates.

programs.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
programs.program_name: Business New Construction — Energy Efficient Buildings (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Energy Design Assistance program for projects at or greater than 50,000 sq. ft. Rebates based on incremental energy savings compared to applicable Energy Standard (ASHRAE 90.1). Pre-approval required. Includes lighting power density (LPD) compliance component.

programs.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
programs.stacking_rules: Can stack with prescriptive/custom rebates; demand response is a separate program track
programs.program_notes_ai: Customers can reduce demand and energy bill by adjusting usage patterns during peak periods. Includes interruptible rate schedules and load control programs. Participants help support Colorado's energy efficiency and sustainability goals. TOU rates available for eligible commercial customers.

Program covers LED lighting, lighting controls, HVAC, motors/VFDs, refrigeration, and Building Energy Management Systems (up to $10,000/BEMS). Total rebate amount per application capped at 50% of total labor, material, and equipment costs. DLC Qualified Products List required for lighting at designlights.org/search. HVAC fans must operate in excess of 4,000 hours to qualify. Applications processed first-come, first-served; program ends when budget is depleted. Equipment must be purchased and installed Jan 1–Dec 31, 2025.

required_documents: Online or printable custom rebate application
programs.stacking_rules: Cannot combine prescriptive and custom rebate for same measure
programs.program_notes_ai: Encourages commercial and industrial customers to replace less energy-efficient equipment with custom rebates not covered by the prescriptive program. Pre-approval required. Apply via online application or printable form at blackhillsenergy.com. Funding is limited and processed first-come, first-served.

Available to commercial customers in Colorado and Wyoming. Designed to help small businesses become more energy efficient via direct installation of measures at no or low cost. Administered through Franklin Energy; contact BlackHillsSBDI@franklinenergy.com or 888-391-8702. Contractor prequalification required.

programs.stacking_rules: Stackable with Energy Smart Colorado partner rebates (CORE or WMSC); one combined application covers both HCE and partner rebates
programs.program_notes_ai: Pre-approval for Commercial/Multifamily Rebates now available with written approval letter upon request. Rebate capped at 25% of total project cost (material and contractor labor only; no tax, travel, mileage, delivery, or permit expenses). Equipment must be installed in HCE service territory and in working order. Member must have active account in good standing. HCE reserves right to inspect installed measures. Eligible measures include lighting, motors, HVAC heat pump conversions, heat pump water heaters, VRF systems, ground-source heat pumps, pool pumps, and food service equipment.

programs.stacking_rules: Stackable with Energy Smart Colorado partner rebates
programs.program_notes_ai: New construction projects for commercial and multifamily members. Pre-approval available with written approval letter. Rebate capped at 25% of total project cost. Member account must be in good standing. Apply via holycross.com/rebates.

Municipal utility offering commercial rebates for energy-efficient equipment including lighting, HVAC, and other measures. Contact Business Services at 719-448-4800 for program specifics and current rebate amounts.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.description: Small commercial customers without demand metering; typically <25 kW peak demand. No demand charge.
rate_schedules.notes: Rate subject to change pending 2025 rate case filing. See current Electric Rate Book at xcelenergy.com/Rates for exact figures.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.description: General commercial service delivered at secondary voltage; typically 25 kW to 1,000 kW. Includes demand metering.
rate_schedules.notes: Rate subject to change pending 2025 rate case. See current Electric Rate Book at xcelenergy.com/Rates for exact figures.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.description: TOU version of GS for medium commercial customers. On-Peak: weekday afternoons/evenings; Off-Peak: all other hours. Summer rates higher than non-summer.
rate_schedules.notes: PUC finalized new TOU on-peak periods (5PM–9PM non-holiday weekdays year-round) effective no earlier than Oct. 2025 (Proceeding 24AL-0377E). See rate book for exact current figures.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.description: For customers with electric power supplied at primary voltage; typically >1,000 kW or meeting primary metering criteria.
rate_schedules.notes: Primary voltage service; customer owns and maintains primary-side equipment. Rate subject to change. See current Electric Rate Book.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.description: TOU version of GP schedule for large commercial and industrial customers at primary voltage. On-Peak and Off-Peak periods vary by season.
rate_schedules.notes: Rate subject to change pending 2025 rate case. See current Electric Rate Book at xcelenergy.com/Rates.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.description: Available to large industrial/commercial customers willing to accept service interruption during peak demand periods. Lower rate in exchange for interruptibility.
rate_schedules.notes: Requires curtailment agreement. Rate subject to change. See current Electric Rate Book.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.description: Rate schedule for outdoor/area lighting customers including municipalities and commercial outdoor lighting. Billed per fixture per month.
rate_schedules.notes: Billed on a per-fixture monthly basis. Exact rates by fixture type in Electric Rate Book at xcelenergy.com/Rates.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule EV-C — Electric Vehicle Commercial Charging
rate_schedules.description: Special rate schedule for commercial electric vehicle charging stations. Designed to support fleet electrification and commercial EV charging infrastructure.
rate_schedules.notes: Designed specifically for EV charging or ancillary EV usage per CO Business Rate Brochure. See current Electric Rate Book at xcelenergy.com/Rates for current figures.

rate_schedules.description: Small commercial/general service at secondary voltage without demand metering. Typically <25 kW.
rate_schedules.notes: Rate subject to PUC approval following April 2025 final decision in Black Hills Electric Rate Case (Proceeding 24AL-0275E). See current tariff at blackhillsenergy.com for exact figures.

rate_schedules.description: Medium commercial service with demand metering at secondary voltage. Updated per April 2025 rate case decision.
rate_schedules.notes: Final decision in Proceeding 24AL-0275E issued April 2025. Verify exact current rates at blackhillsenergy.com tariffs page.

rate_schedules.description: Large commercial or industrial service at primary voltage. Higher demand threshold than Schedule 32.
rate_schedules.notes: Rate updated per April 2025 PUC rate case decision. See current tariff at blackhillsenergy.com.

rate_schedules.description: Standard commercial service schedule for small to medium commercial members of Holy Cross Energy.
rate_schedules.notes: Holy Cross delivers ~90% clean energy. Exact current rates available at holycross.com/about/rates-and-tariffs/.

rate_schedules.description: Commercial demand service with demand metering for medium to large commercial Holy Cross Energy members.
rate_schedules.notes: Exact current rates available at holycross.com/about/rates-and-tariffs/.
